$comment: Data, not code: upstream's names and what they became. `identity` is what the name guard (scripts/plugin-engine/names.mjs) forbids. `rules` are the renames plugin source written for upstream's framework needs to build and run on Opensteer's; one rewriter applies them, `rewriteUpstreamSource` and `rewriteUpstreamPackage` from @opensteer/plugin-engine-catalog, for the catalog snapshot and its qualification. A rule applies only within its scope; see `scopes`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive unless a scope says otherwise. Prose and comments are not rules here: they change nothing a build or a run reads, and the catalog snapshot edits them on top.

scopes.package: A package name's prefix: a catalog index entry's `package`, a source document's `package`, and the `name` of a plugin's package.json.
scopes.manifest-key: A top-level key of a plugin's package.json, renamed with its value kept. A package.json with both keys is refused.
scopes.route-path: Code files: a reserved route path that starts a literal, as the language reads it: in scripts a string, a template without substitutions or a template's head, found by the TypeScript parser; in pages a tag's attribute value and the literals of inline scripts and stylesheets; in stylesheets a url() or @import string. A root-relative path only, never an absolute or protocol-relative URL, a comment, another string or other text.
scopes.header: Code files: a header name, matched without regard to case.
scopes.element-id: Code files: an element id the framework puts in an app's page.
scopes.event: Code files: the window event the framework dispatches when a new version is active.
scopes.ui-marker: Code files: the marker the framework puts in an app's page.
scopes.error-code: Code files: an error code the Host returns to app code.
scopes.reserved-table: A table the framework keeps in an app's SQLite database. In code files a whole word in any case; in migrations/*.sql only complete SQL identifiers, bare or quoted and in any case, never string literals or comments (packages/plugin-engine/catalog/src/implementation/reserved-tables.ts).
scopes.signing-secret: Code files: the value of a `signingSecret` property in a manual webhook setup.
